pack.title: Group-chat jabs
pack.description: Roasts with an audience of twelve. Win the thread without losing the friend.

scenarios.setting: The group chat. You share good news; a friend quote-tweets it with a jab.

replies.line: Main character with good news. Thanks for noticing.
replies.why: Owning the frame turns the jab into a compliment with witnesses.
It steps over the jab and re-centers your news in five words.

replies.line: Haha — supporting cast gets dinner when I celebrate.
replies.why: Casting him in your story converts the heckler into a guest.

replies.line: Somebody has to carry this chat's plot.
replies.why: Accepting the role with absurd confidence makes the thread yours.
Upgrading the title steals the joke and wears it better.

trap.line: At least I HAVE news. What have you done lately?
trap.why: Counter-punching in the chat turns banter into a scoreboard nobody wins.

scenarios.setting: The group chat. An old embarrassing photo of you resurfaces.
scenarios.jab: throwback to when you looked like THIS 💀

replies.why: Agreeing at full volume leaves the joke with nowhere to go.

replies.line: A masterpiece. Printing it for your birthday.
replies.why: Loving the photo plus a gentle threat keeps the thread fun and finite.

replies.line: We don't talk about the bangs era.
replies.why: Naming the era yourself makes you the narrator instead of the target.

replies.line: Delete it and I'll deny everything.
replies.why: A fake cover-up treats the photo as classified, which buries the roast.
